children: Aptos proposes MonoMove, an execution engine for smart contracts. The proposal claims up to 55 times faster execution and includes protections built into the engine for institutional use.

MonoMove's rollout is subject to a governance vote planned for 2027. The proposed engine is not yet a live network upgrade. Its near-term effect on APT's outlook comes from expectations around the proposal, with the vote determining whether rollout can proceed.
Aptos' newly proposed execution engine runs the smart contracts behind every onchain market up to 55x faster, with engine-level protections built for institutional use.
Rollout is pending a governance vote planned for 2027. More via
